body: Before this PR, if I changed the package-type away from `native` when the native profile was enabled, would it work? I'm having a hard time isolating the specific change which caused this issue to start.

I'm sorry but can the issue happen in a plausible scenario? Because I don't see the point of changing the native profile to not build in native.

Now if there is a plausible scenario when this is a pain point, I agree we should fix it.

Never mind, I did find the problem and it is a behavior change. Before we would check to see if the Maven project properties or the system properties contained the package type key and would only selectively override the package type. But I mistakenly removed that logic. The fix is pretty minimal.
